messages.content: You are a bounded pre-publication reviewer. Review only the exact diff supplied. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL followed by concrete action items. Check host-process safety, Jenkins-measured exception ancestry and timing, effect suppression, alias/cycle correctness, budget safety, regressions, tests/evidence quality, and scope. Do not suggest unrelated refactors.

Review the exact local fix for two PR #110 findings on base 80ab8a244a3f918bf9bd6c786764751ea349bf75. Requirements: direct-self list/map display and interpolation retain Jenkins markers, but any cyclic typed collection passed as a positional or named hosted-step argument must raise typed StackOverflowError ancestry after argument evaluation and before Perform, with zero hosted effects and no display placeholder reaching dispatch. Distinct cyclic list/map ==, !=, contains, switch equality, cyclic ordering, longer-cycle display, and cyclic map-key reads/writes must share one typed Error-ancestry fault family; catch(Exception) cannot intercept it, while Error/Throwable can. Same-identity cyclic equality remains true. Reference-cycle detection must be host-stack-safe and must not reject repeated acyclic aliases. Unmodelled hashCode/toSet/unique remain explicit safe refusals. Two new Jenkins 2.568.1 cases must be tier-1 PROVEN with empty workspace; scorecard 228/228, 229 seals, corpus admitted197/tier3=30. +// PR #110 exact-head review closure. Every recursive equality/hash walk keeps
+// StackOverflowError ancestry; same-identity cycles and display-only direct-self
+// markers retain Jenkins' non-recursive fast paths.
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('P') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    def left = [null]
+                    def right = [null]
+                    left[0] = left
+                    right[0] = right
+                    echo "identity:${left == left}:${left}"
+
+                    try {
+                        echo "equal:${left == right}"
+                        echo 'equal:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'equal:caught'
+                    }
+
+                    try {
+                        echo "contains:${[left].contains(right)}"
+                        echo 'contains:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'contains:caught'
+                    }
+
+                    def leftMap = [self: null]
+                    def rightMap = [self: null]
+                    leftMap.self = leftMap
+                    rightMap.self = rightMap
+
+                    try {
+                        echo "map-equal:${leftMap == rightMap}"
+                        echo 'map-equal:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'map-equal:caught'
+                    }
+
+                    def keyed = [:]
+                    try {
+                        keyed[left] = 'x'
+                        echo 'map-key:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo "map-key:caught:${keyed.size()}"
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// PR #110 exact-head review closure. A direct-self marker is legal only after
+// interpolation has produced an ordinary String. Passing any cyclic typed
+// collection to a hosted step raises StackOverflowError before dispatch.
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('P') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    def direct = [null]
+                    direct[0] = direct
+                    echo "marker:${direct}"
+
+                    try {
+                        echo direct
+                        echo 'direct-echo:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'direct-echo:caught'
+                    }
+
+                    try {
+                        sh script: direct
+                        echo 'direct-sh:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'direct-sh:caught'
+                    }
+
+                    def longer = [null]
+                    longer[0] = [back: longer]
+
+                    try {
+                        echo message: longer
+                        echo 'long-echo:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'long-echo:caught'
+                    }
+
+                    try {
+                        echo "${longer}"
+                        echo 'long-interpolation:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        echo 'long-interpolation:caught'
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+    /// has direct-self markers, but Jenkins' step argument coercion/hash path

+    /// Repeated aliases on sibling paths are not cycles, so the active path —
+    /// rather than one global visited set — is the boundary.
+    let hasReferenceCycle value =

+        let mutable cycle = false
+
